import pandas as pd
path = '/data/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

# Load with proper parsing
field_raw = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=None)
field_header = field_raw.iloc[4].tolist()
field_data = field_raw.iloc[5:].reset_index(drop=True)
field_data.columns = field_header
field = field_data[['Transaction ID','Transaction Date','Cost Centre','Expense Head','Vendor / Payee','Amount (INR)','Posting Status']].copy()

salary_raw = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=None)
salary_header = salary_raw.iloc[5].tolist()
salary_data = salary_raw.iloc[6:].reset_index(drop=True)
salary_data.columns = salary_header
salary = salary_data[['Payroll Line ID','Pay Month','Employee ID','Role','Cost Centre','Gross Salary (INR)','Payroll Status']].copy()

lookup_raw = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=None)
lookup_header = lookup_raw.iloc[3].tolist()
lookup_data = lookup_raw.iloc[4:].reset_index(drop=True)
lookup_data.columns = lookup_header
lookup = lookup_data[['Cost Centre Code','Programme','District','State','Primary Funder']].copy()

# Clean strings
def clean_str(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return ''
    return str(s).strip()

for col in field.columns:
    field[col] = field[col].apply(clean_str)
for col in salary.columns:
    salary[col] = salary[col].apply(clean_str)
for col in lookup.columns:
    lookup[col] = lookup[col].apply(clean_str)

# Normalize cost centre codes
field['cost_norm'] = field['Cost Centre'].str.strip().str.lower()
salary['cost_norm'] = salary['Cost Centre'].str.strip().str.lower()
lookup['cost_norm'] = lookup['Cost Centre Code'].str.strip().str.lower()

# Filter field: Transaction ID beginning FE- and Posting Status Posted (case-insensitive)
field_filtered = field[
    field['Transaction ID'].str.startswith('FE-') &
    field['Posting Status'].str.lower() == 'posted'
].copy()

# Filter salary: Payroll Line ID beginning PAY- and Payroll Status Paid
salary_filtered = salary[
    salary['Payroll Line ID'].str.startswith('PAY-') &
    salary['Payroll Status'].str.lower() == 'paid'
].copy()

# Build lookup mapping cost_norm -> district
lookup_map = lookup.set_index('cost_norm')['District'].to_dict()
# Also need to check unmapped codes are excluded; mapping only those present

# Count lines where cost_norm in lookup and district == 'Barmer' (case-insensitive)
field_filtered['district'] = field_filtered['cost_norm'].map(lookup_map)
field_barmer = field_filtered[field_filtered['district'].str.lower() == 'barmer']
salary_filtered['district'] = salary_filtered['cost_norm'].map(lookup_map)
salary_barmer = salary_filtered[salary_filtered['district'].str.lower() == 'barmer']

print('Field filtered count', len(field_filtered))
print('Salary filtered count', len(salary_filtered))
print('Field Barmer count', len(field_barmer))
print('Salary Barmer count', len(salary_barmer))
print('Total', len(field_barmer) + len(salary_barmer))
# Show some examples
print(field_barmer[['Transaction ID','Cost Centre','district']].head())
print(salary_barmer[['Payroll Line ID','Cost Centre','district']].head())
